fact: A NISSA official told the Libyan News Agency in January 2025 that the Authority launched the National Cybersecurity Strategy in February 2023 and has taken urgent measures against denial-of-service, phishing and ransomware attacks on Libyan institutions.
title: الهيئة الوطنية لأمن وسلامة المعلومات: تعزيز الأمن السيبراني وحماية البنية الرقمية
